name: Lady
source:
??? - life leech - f

Lady is a charismatic woman who's been alive for an unspoken number of centuries. Her kind is extremely rare, but when one is born, they tend to keep on living until they choose to stop leeching life from others. She runs a bar, appropriately named Lady's Bar. She's a hard worker and a faithful friend.

"I'm forever 121♥"

[From [url=http://www.duenkhy.com/]official site[/url]]
